## Workflow C — Feedback Handler (Twilio)

### Twilio webhook setup
Configure the Sandbox **When a message comes in** URL as:
`https://your-n8n.com/webhook/whatsapp-webhook` using HTTP POST.

### Stage 1 — commitment (two-stage nudges only)
| Button / typed text | Stored `commitment_response` | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | `YES` | Status → `awaiting_followup`; the outcome check becomes eligible at `followup_due_at` |
| No | `NO` | Status → `declined`; `followup_due_at` cleared so no check is ever sent |
| (no reply) | `NO_FEEDBACK` | Written by Workflow F when the window closes — never `NOT_YET` |

A repeated Yes is recorded as `commitment_repeat`: it refreshes
`response_wa_id` only and never touches `followup_due_at`, so a duplicated
webhook cannot arm a second follow-up.

### Stage 2 — outcome (sent by Workflow F)
| Button / typed text | Stored `outcome_response` | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Done | `DONE` | Mark done and increment completion/streak once |
| Not yet | `NOT_YET` | Mark not yet and ask what got in the way (existing barrier flow) |
| (no reply) | `NO_FEEDBACK` | Written by Workflow F when the window closes |

### Single-stage nudges (unchanged)
Done / In progress / Not yet behave exactly as before and write `response`.

### Correlation
`OriginalRepliedMessageSid` is matched against `followup_wa_id` (stage 2),
`barrier_followup_wa_id` (barrier), then `wa_message_id` (stage 1 or
single-stage), so a reply always resolves to the question it answers. A typed
reply with no context resolves to the patient's most recently asked open
question. `response_wa_id` makes webhook retries idempotent.

### STOP
Typed `STOP` opts the patient out immediately, cancels **every** pending
commitment and follow-up, and sends one confirmation. If Twilio Advanced Opt-Out
already handled the keyword it supplies `OptOutType=STOP`; the opt-out is then
persisted identically but **no second confirmation is sent**, because Twilio has
already replied.

### Required environment variables
`GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`, `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM`.

### Required Sheet columns
`schedule_state` needs `response_wa_id`, `parent_nudge_id`, `delivered_at`,
`followup_enabled`, `followup_delay_hours`, `commitment_response`,
`commitment_responded_at`, `followup_due_at`, `followup_sent_at`,
`followup_wa_id`, `outcome_response` and `outcome_responded_at` before activation.

This workflow is suitable for bounded Sandbox testing. Add Twilio request-signature validation before participant use.
